title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Cancel a Reservation (24-Hour Policy)
content:
Users can cancel a reservation in the CultPass app under 'My Reservations' > select the event > 'Cancel Reservation'.

- Cancellations made at least 24 hours before the event return the credit to the monthly quota
- Cancellations less than 24 hours before the event count as a used experience; exceptions require approval from a human agent
- No-shows count as a used experience
- Support agents can cancel on the user's behalf if the 24-hour rule is respected

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel in the app under 'My Reservations'. If you cancel at least 24 hours before the event, the experience goes back to your monthly quota."

title: Account Blocked or Suspended
content:
Accounts can be blocked automatically after suspicious activity (e.g. shared QR codes, multiple failed payments, or reported misuse).

- A blocked user cannot log in or make reservations
- Support AI agents cannot unblock accounts
- Always escalate to a human agent with the user's ID and a summary of the issue
- Tell the user the review usually takes 1-2 business days

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your account is currently blocked for a security review. I've forwarded your case to our support team, who will review it and contact you by email within 1-2 business days."

title: Refund Requests and Billing Disputes
content:
CultPass does not issue automatic refunds.

- Refunds, duplicate charges and billing disputes must be escalated to a human agent (support lead approval required)
- Collect: date of the charge, amount, last 4 digits of the card (never the full number)
- Do not promise a refund or a timeline for one
- Billing team replies within 3 business days

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I'm sorry about the trouble with your charge. I've forwarded your request to our billing team, who will review it and reply within 3 business days."
tags: refund, money back, billing, charge, duplicate charge, payment, dispute, escalation

title: Premium Experiences and Subscription Tiers
content:
CultPass has two tiers:

- Basic: standard experiences included in the monthly quota
- Premium: standard and premium experiences (VIP tours, special concerts) included in the quota

Basic members can still attend premium experiences by paying the extra fee shown in the app at checkout, or by upgrading to Premium via 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'. Upgrades take effect immediately.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Premium experiences are included for Premium members. On the Basic plan you can book them in the app by paying the extra fee shown at checkout, or upgrade anytime under 'Manage Plan'."
tags: premium, tier, upgrade, basic, pricing, experiences

title: Monthly Quota and Unused Experiences
content:
Each subscription has a monthly quota of experiences (shown in 'My Account').

- The quota resets on the first day of each month
- Unused experiences do not roll over to the next month
- Cancelled reservations (more than 24h before the event) return the credit to the quota
- When the quota is used up, new reservations are blocked until the next month or a plan upgrade

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your quota resets on the 1st of every month and unused experiences don't roll over. You can see your remaining experiences under 'My Account'."

title: Updating Payment Method and Failed Payments
content:
To update a card: app > 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods' > 'Add card', then set it as default.

- If a payment fails, CultPass retries automatically after 3 days
- After 2 failed attempts the subscription is paused until payment succeeds
- Reservations remain valid while the payment is being retried
- Never ask users to share full card numbers in chat

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your card in 'My Account' > 'Payment Methods'. Once a valid card is set as default, we'll retry the payment automatically."
tags: payment, card, billing, failed payment, subscription

title: App Troubleshooting: Crashes and QR Code Not Showing
content:
For app issues, guide the user through these steps:

1. Update the CultPass app to the latest version
2. Check internet connection; the QR code needs to be loaded online once, then works offline
3. Log out and log back in to refresh tickets
4. Clear the app cache (Android) or reinstall the app (iOS)
5. If the QR code still does not show at the venue, staff can validate the reservation by the user's email

If the problem persists after these steps, escalate to technical support with device model and app version.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please update the app and log out and back in - that refreshes your QR codes. If it still doesn't appear, venue staff can check you in with your email."
tags: app, crash, bug, qr code, technical, troubleshooting

title: Changing Account Email or Personal Details
content:
Users can change their name and phone number in 'My Account' > 'Profile'.

- Changing the login email requires verification: a confirmation link is sent to the new address
- If the user no longer has access to the old email, escalate to a human agent for identity verification
- Support agents must never change emails based only on a chat request

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your details under 'My Account' > 'Profile'. For a new email, we'll send a confirmation link to the new address."
tags: email, profile, account, personal data, verification

title: Bringing a Guest to an Experience
content:
Each reservation is personal and valid for one person.

- Guests need their own CultPass reservation, or can buy a guest ticket in the app where the event allows it ('Add guest' on the event page)
- Guest tickets are paid separately and do not use the member's quota
- QR codes cannot be shared; sharing may lead to the account being blocked

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Reservations are for one person, but many events let you add a paid guest ticket from the event page in the app."
tags: guest, friend, plus one, ticket, sharing

title: Event Cancelled or Changed by the Venue
content:
If a partner venue cancels or reschedules an experience:

- Users receive a push notification and an email
- The credit is automatically returned to the monthly quota (even if within 24 hours)
- For rescheduled events, the reservation stays valid for the new date; users can cancel without penalty if the new date does not work
- Weather-related cancellations of outdoor experiences follow the same rule

**Suggested phrasing:**
"When a venue cancels an event, the experience is returned to your quota automatically. If it was rescheduled, your reservation moves to the new date, and you can cancel it at no cost if that doesn't work for you."
tags: event cancelled, rescheduled, venue, weather, credit

title: Accessibility and Special Assistance
content:
CultPass partners provide accessibility information on each event page (wheelchair access, audio description, sign language).

- Users can request special assistance in the app when reserving ('Accessibility needs' field)
- Requests should be made at least 48 hours in advance
- One companion of a user with disabilities may attend for free at participating venues

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Each event page lists its accessibility features. When reserving, add your needs in the 'Accessibility needs' field at least 48 hours ahead and the venue will prepare for you."

title: Data Privacy and Deleting Your Account
content:
CultPass complies with Brazil's LGPD data protection law.

- Users can download their data in 'My Account' > 'Privacy' > 'Export my data'
- Account deletion: 'My Account' > 'Privacy' > 'Delete account'; it cancels the subscription and removes personal data within 30 days
- Deletion is irreversible; active reservations are cancelled
- For other privacy requests, escalate to the data protection team via a human agent

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can export or delete your data under 'My Account' > 'Privacy'. Deleting your account is permanent and cancels your subscription and reservations."
tags: privacy, data, lgpd, delete account, gdpr
